title: Lachlan Morton’s Latest Challenge: Beat the Horses of the Old Pony Express
content:
The Australian who calls California home will try to do the 1,900-mile mixed terrain route in just under eight days with a combination of three different types of bikes.

Read the full article at Lachlan Morton’s Latest Challenge: Beat the Horses of the Old Pony Express on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
